name: Media Generation
description: Generative-media producers: image generation (sd.cpp / cloud), video generation, and GIF search. Governance shell over the in-crate media module. The shared no-cloud blob store (/api/media/:file serve, /api/media/upload) stays kernel storage — it also serves TTS audio + chat uploads.

permission_levels.label: Can generate media
permission_levels.description: Generate images and video on this node, which spends GPU time locally or model credits in the cloud.
